```renyi
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let gross be subtotal(invoice)
  let discount be gross * invoice.discount_percent / 100
  return (gross - discount).rounded(places: 2)
end
```
